title: Investigating Tax Evasion Emergence Using Dual Large Language Model and Deep Reinforcement Learning Powered Agent-Based Simulation
reasoning: The paper includes a significant component evaluating moral and ethical reasoning within an LLM-powered simulation. It creates specific agent archetypes based on 'law-abiding' and 'ethical decision-making' traits to study tax compliance. The study explicitly explores how 'individual morality', 'moral obligation', and 'ethical beliefs'—instantiated through prompts to LLMs—influence economic behavior and tax evasion emergence.
